name: T.S. Lines Limited
summary: T.S. Lines Limited, an investment holding company, provides shipping container and related services in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, the Philippines, Japan, Australia, Thailand, India, and internationally. It offers vessel chartering and shipping agency services. The company operates a fleet of owned vessels and chartered vessels. It serves freight forwarders; other container shipping companies; and BCO customers, such as small and medium-sized businesses, including manufacturers of consumer, primary, and mechanical products. T.S. Lines Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
